address: 4F, Grand Victoria Hotel, 168 Jingye 4th Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, 104, Taiwan
bio: A must for steak lovers, this place serves premium cuts such as USDA prime dry-aged ribeye, Australian grade 9+ beef and Japan's renowned Miyazaki A5 Wagyu – all grilled to perfection in an oak wood-fired oven that imbues the meat with a lovely smokiness. The set menu is impressive value for money considering the quality delivered. Glimpses into the open kitchen and the chefs' choreography add an element of drama to the culinary experience.
